title: What's new in v3.1
intro: PornPics Importer now includes a performer profile image finder.
items: Added Search with PornPics Importer button next to Stash's performer image control.
Browse performer photos in a dedicated popup with portrait-oriented images shown first.
Choose one photo and apply it directly as the Stash performer profile image.
The selected file is stored separately inside the plugin and is not imported as a Stash image, gallery or metadata item.
